business_summary: HOUSEI Inc. engages in the information systems business in Japan and internationally. The company offers page production, advertising management, page management, and sales management for newspaper companies; production and editing software, layout management, and content management, and systems related to print publication for publishers; apps and cloud services; contract system development; IT engineer dispatch services for manufacturing, finance, and service industries; school report systems and automated grading software; product solution development and logistics; and IT services. It also provides software platforms, such as imprai ezBI, imprai, imprai ezCheck, Pixtock, British Spirit, eRESERvest, NOVO, WelcomID, Square Box, ezRepo, Customer IQ, Megalith, Dandelion, ezOrder Solution, Mobius, Bottle Keep Benrikun, ElecRoc6090 SP, SkyEdit IBIS automatic typesetting, FORE C, Founder Pack, EagleRIP Flexo 5.1, Advertising System, Bargain Manager Ver4.1, Fangzheng Chine outline font, Hoseiji Library, Halftone dots, DocuDefend, SuperLine, ElecRoc 5, FNP-X, Electronic Publishing, News Media Stand, and EagleDot. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
